gaps: BC Government Directory (dir.gov.bc.ca) no longer allows public access, so branch placement could not be cross-checked there.
Office of the Chief Information Officer: not named in any 2026 source read; Connected Services BC now holds the government IT strategy, security and standards role. Not recorded separately.

Emergency Management BC: the name no longer appears on EMCR's 2026 pages or service plan (the ministry replaced EMBC in 2022). Not recorded; EMCR's public programs (ESS, DFA, PreparedBC, EmergencyInfoBC, ClimateReadyBC) are recorded instead.
Climate Action Secretariat: confirmed only by the 2025/26 ECS service plan; the 2026/27 documents name only a 'Climate Action' sub-vote.
Only the AG and PSSG publish public org charts. Other ministries' division names come from 2026/27 Estimates sub-votes and service plans, which can differ from internal branch names.
Establishment years are given only where the page states them (BC Prosecution Service 1974, Declaration Act Secretariat 2022, Container Trucking Commissioner 2014). All others are null.
Infrastructure, Jobs and Economic Growth, and Emergency Management and Climate Readiness have few distinct named public-facing units; those records are thinner (3 to 6).
GeoBC, Recreation Sites and Trails' parent history, and WLRS fish and wildlife licensing branches were not recorded, because no current source ties them to a ministry.
Tribunals the Attorney General administers for other ministries (such as the Environmental Appeal Board, Forest Appeals Commission and Passenger Transportation Board) were not recorded individually.
